The repository is `Clivecchi/keeper-platform`, branch `cloud`, reported HEAD `97048fc41c7cc44bc7330e0b51fa3453898e4443`; contrary to Cloud’s description of bare errors, the receipts explicitly report missing paths `apps/api/src/lib/castRoom` and `apps/api/src/hooks`, with nearby entries. No receipt-path code findings, tests, or deployed-behavior proof were returned; Ceox and Rendr returned nothing this turn.

I’m requesting the stored source and Document bodies before updating the existing work record. Cloud owns repository path recovery and the receipt-to-Lead-evaluation check; Cursor owns the bounded fallback investigation if that execution path cannot continue. Point 33 and its existing Gloss remain untouched: Gloss retrieval is still unproven, and no identity-preserving update or new write receipt exists. Completion requires commit-specific code evidence for empty-prose receipts reaching Lead context and evaluation, a preserved work-record update, and your subsequent reload retrieval.
